messageHeadline: fix(scripts): reconcile check-closing-keywords.mjs against GitHub's own closingIssuesReferences (#1730)
messageBody:
The deploy-only-path check silently passed a genuine closing-keyword hit
whenever the changed paths were ordinary, with nothing checking whether
GitHub's own `closingIssuesReferences` actually confirmed the close. Merged
PR #1680's body read (in context) "the one-word fix #1664 asked for" --
mid-sentence prose, not a deliberate `Closes #N` trailer -- alongside its own
explicit `Refs #1664` elsewhere. `closingIssuesReferences` read #1664 while
the PR was in that state; `assess()` returned `ok: true`. Release Guards
reported SUCCESS. Only a human reword before merge kept #1664 open.
